title: Healthy Eating at the School Canteen
audience: Chinese senior high school students (16-18 years old, average level in mainland China)
imageAlt: A busy school canteen at lunchtime: students in blue and white uniforms choosing food at a counter with a menu board, a healthy eating poster on the wall
imageDescription: A busy school canteen at lunchtime. Four students in blue and white sports uniforms stand at the front: Li Ping holds a tray with rice, steamed fish, vegetables and soup; Wang Ming holds a hamburger, French fries, a barbecue skewer and a slice of cake; Susan holds only a small salad and a glass of juice; a tall boy waits with an empty tray. Behind them a glass counter shows labelled food trays and a green menu board lists prices: Rice 2, Fish 4, Salad 3, Soup 2, Milk 1, Cake 3, Juice 4, Hamburgers 3. A HEALTHY EATING poster on the wall shows a food pyramid with the words EAT WELL, LIVE WELL, BE WELL. Other students eat at tables and a worker serves rice.
scoringDescription: A busy school canteen at lunchtime, about 12:05 by the wall clock. Four Chinese senior high students wear blue and white sports uniforms. Li Ping, a girl with a black ponytail, holds a tray with rice, steamed fish, broccoli and carrots, and a bowl of soup, a balanced healthy meal. Wang Ming, a cheerful boy, holds a hamburger, French fries, a barbecue meat skewer and a slice of cream cake. Susan, a short-haired girl with a finger on her chin, holds only a small green salad and a glass of orange juice, looking thoughtful about her light meal; a tall smiling boy waits behind with an empty tray. The glass counter shows labelled trays: rice, steamed fish, chicken, beef noodles, vegetables, salad, eggs, milk, orange juice, hamburgers, French fries, cake. The green menu board lists prices in yuan: Rice 2, Fish 4, Salad 3, Soup 2, Milk 1, Cake 3, Juice 4, Hamburgers 3. On the wall a HEALTHY EATING poster shows a food pyramid of grain at the bottom, vegetables and fruit above, meat and milk at the top, and the slogan EAT WELL, LIVE WELL, BE WELL. In the background a worker in a white cap scoops rice, students eat at tables, and a cleaner wipes one. The scene contrasts a balanced meal (Li Ping), fast food (Wang Ming) and skipping meals (Susan).
